scope: Qualify 5 us main before the two remaining d-only native runs under the original four-variant protocol.

admission.physical: Use the exact fine-run DC-negative numerical reference point and original native measurements relative to AC neutral. Require the 19 oriented branch roles, 14 non-ground nodes, all measure polarities and 45 output slots.
admission.control: Use the archived coarse sequence, with 20-step controller updates, retained coarse STORF 62 allocation, pending values applied on the next 5 us row, and both original main command edges. Permit only the two reduced trig operands besides the proven gauge transformation. Keep original unwrapped logging and control arithmetic.
admission.execution: One isolated same-session native Build and a conditional Run. Save complete raw output on original clock through 0.200005 s and verify generated semantic admission after runtime refresh.
admission.numerical: Use the prevalidated independent configured-angle high-precision expected path and original per-field bounds including 1 pV on e_q. Apply all 19 original electrical limits, timing, t0, exact state and tracking controls on all 40002 rows.

comparison: On coarse qualification compare against independently solved same-grid PyCy in all original windows and evaluate the native fine/coarse main pair. Both d-only native runs remain required before paired-scenario, full reference and formal example acceptance.
remaining_d_only: The two d-only variants retain each grid's own clock, state, reference point and reduced-angle law and omit only the 80 ms q command. Authorize and bind their own scope before native execution.
